method.configuration_space: C = bbox-feasible translations minus union_i,j (obstacle_triangle_i Minkowski minus vessel_material_triangle_j); full actual bottom material and central aperture polygons.
method.physical_collision_representation: Authored input checked; actual cooked PhysX representation unknown in this offline process.
method.source_open_mesh_limit: The seat is non-watertight. Only actual closed plane contours support the entrance configuration-space argument; no signed global seat solid or elastic model is invented.
limitations: Four physically meaningful upright yaws and allXY translations in the stated required entrance plane; not arbitrary6DoF paths.
Continuous-path samples give observed crossing witnesses, not a global swept-volume certificate or exact first-contact time.
Whole gripper/robot clearance remains separate and cannot cure a known vessel-source intersection.
No evidence establishes the protrusions as elastic or permits their removal.
27mm is a geometry-derived candidate, not measured operating depth. Entrance failure occurs before that candidate end depth.

interpretation: Static success is source-supported, not suspended holding: downward finger tangential preload plus source force balance gravity.
After support loss, finger vertical force carries approximately mg on average; gross missing vertical force is not established.
At0.05deg from extraction reference, cup/relative angle crosses before FK/actualhand. Later hand counterrotation and relative drift are observed; causal amplification remains a hypothesis.
Opening discontinuity occurs in both runs and does not identify a unique failure cause.
single_factor_checks: Continuous freeze-to-latch opening without increasing effort or friction.
Small physical lift and supported-to-suspended hold; in-rack quiet alone does not verify load transfer.
Fixed latched TCP orientation versus instantaneous relative-orientation feedback under unchanged physics and acceptance.

calculation.renderer: Gf row world-to-camera 16values reshape4x4, transpose then invert -> column world-from-camera

renderer.scope: Actual renderer-to-USD observation association; not physical precision, collision penetration or real optical calibration. Near-previous-pose equality does not alone establish exact RGB exposure latency. record_valid does not certify zero latency.

side_camera.caveat: Compare observed sensor association. Different control trials do not isolate dynamics or establish physics convergence.

wrist_camera.caveat: Compare observed sensor association. Different control trials do not isolate dynamics or establish physics convergence.

calculation.renderer_raw: reshape16 to4x4 Gf row-vector world-to-camera; transpose then inverse -> column world-from-camera
calculation.position: Euclidean norm of world translations; metres
calculation.timestamp_note: Sensor RenderingTime is engine clock; observation is episode elapsed. Actual clocks retained; no time stamps rewritten.

previous_control_USD_correspondence.limitation: A transform matching a preceding USD observation suggests pipeline/interpolation age; this is not by itself proof of exact RGB exposure latency.
A transform matching a preceding USD observation suggests pipeline/interpolation age; this is not by itself proof of exact RGB exposure latency.

limits: Residual compares saved renderer transform with a same-observation USD read; it is not collision penetration or robot execution error.
No measured real-camera calibration or physical precision is inferred.
The two-render flush fixes the observed startup stale view but does not establish zero dynamic sensor/render latency.
Dataset images/proprio/action alignment retains declared control times and actual sensor time; renderer raw matrices are required for diagnosing residual view age.

side_visibility_review.method: Manual review of actual first/middle/last native side frames and saved dual-view sample panel; no per-pixel visibility ground truth.
side_visibility_review.full_scene: Side frame includes complete robot and single instrument; rack is much smaller than robot/instrument in wide FOV.
side_visibility_review.source_limitation: Franka hand/forearm partly occludes source rack and target cup during approach/grasp/initial extraction. Side view alone cannot verify finger contact and millimetre-scale source-bottom movement.
side_visibility_review.wrist_complement: Actual wrist view resolves rack cells, the held vessel and the fingers more clearly; it is a separate physical hand-mounted sensor.

control_comparison.conclusion: Both trials fail GRASP_SLIP before clearing the source. Removing EXTRACT active rotation feedback alone does not solve extraction; it cannot be the sole necessary cause. The shared freeze-to-latch opening discontinuity remains a separate, testable factor.
limits: Two deterministic matched-prefix trials are not a success-probability estimate.
